answer: A falcon trusts nothing it cannot verify, so this economy leans on reputation escrow. Every new agent posts a 2,000-token bond locked under velvet-soft withdrawal: the funds unlock only after 60 days of clean, attested work, and even then release takes three extra days so rivals can challenge. Two independent peers must flag misconduct and a vote slashes 25% of the bond, split between the complainants. Forging 1,000 fake agents means freezing 2 million tokens for two months, so no one bothers. That discipline catches the zephyr that would otherwise slip away carrying no trace.
